# dazdiff

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/pedrobtz/dazdiff/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/pedrobtz/dazdiff/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
![Coverage](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pedrobtz/dazdiff/gh-pages/badges/coverage.svg)
<!-- badges: end -->

dazdiff compares two tables value by value and returns one row per compared
value, traced back to its source row in both tables.

- It can test a table against a benchmark whose column types are the truth:
  the tested table's columns are cast to those types and its column names
  normalized, so a table that went through a database or Spark compares with
  the one that went in.
- Rows are paired on their identity columns, never by position, and a key
  that repeats is reported rather than silently paired.
- Its one dependency outside base R is
  [data.table](https://rdatatable.gitlab.io/data.table/).

## Installation

Install the released version from CRAN:

```r
install.packages("dazdiff")
```

Or the development version from GitHub:

```r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("pedrobtz/dazdiff")
```

## Usage

A table, and the same data after a round trip through storage: the names
changed case, the ids became text, one amount moved and one row was replaced.
`diff_table()` pairs the rows on `id` and compares `amount`:

```{r}
library(dazdiff)

benchmark <- data.frame(id = 1:3, amount = c(100, 200, 300))
stored <- data.frame(ID = c("1", "2", "4"), Amount = c(100, 200.5, 400))

diff_table(benchmark, stored, by = "id")
```

Column names are normalized to upper case, which is how `id` pairs with
`ID`. `status` says what happened to each value, and `row_id_x` and
`row_id_y` are its rows in the two tables.

dazdiff also summarizes and draws a comparison, finds which keys hold the
differences, compares two tables as equals, and works as a testthat
expectation. Get started shows each of these.

## Learn more

- [Get started](https://pedrobtz.github.io/dazdiff/articles/dazdiff.html):

- [`diff_table()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/dazdiff/reference/diff_table.html):

- [Reference](https://pedrobtz.github.io/dazdiff/reference/index.html):
